runtime_resolution_note: At run start the analyst inspected its own tool surface: shell execution and file tools are available -> runtime_mode = TOOLS_PRESENT. Mode is recorded here and in 00_package_manifest; it is never flipped mid-run (ANOMALY:MODE_FLIP).
language_register: en with Chinese chart terms verbatim (pinyin/gloss on first use)
cost_metric: whitespace_tokens: count of non-space runs in the cap's returned summary object (stand-in for a tokenizer; deterministic)

determinism.id_derivation: sha256 content address; IDs assigned by sorting atoms within type on content_hash (byte-identical across runs for identical inputs)
determinism.ordering: all collections sorted by canonical key before emission
determinism.timestamps: no wall-clock timestamps anywhere in emitted artifacts

tool_provisioning.note: The charter's annex A-tools declares Tier-0/Tier-2 bindings but the harness's external binaries are not present in this repository checkout. Under TOOLS_PRESENT the bindings were provisioned as deterministic run-local executables (tools/*.py) so that CAP lines become real tool invocations and tool output is the authority (law 33). Products are stamped authority=TOOL_OUTPUT (real process output), not EMULATED_TOOL.

degradation_policy: Unsupplied cold inputs are never invented: they degrade only the layers that need them (schema_bind -> least-contradicted bind + ANOMALY:SCHEMA_AMBIGUITY; frozen tables -> annex A-tables fallback flagged in provenance; pattern catalog -> sanctioned minimum-viable stand-in; archetype rubric -> structure-only labels; coverage control -> B0 units derived from the charter, flagged; protocol classes -> BLOCKED). All degradations are listed in 14_gap_report.

lens_amendments.effect: case_context ingestion re-classified from schema-mismatch (CONTEXT_DEGRADED) to free_prose accepted (CONTEXT_FREE_PROSE_ACCEPTED); six slots filled as DECOMPOSED
